title: Security risk analysis
instructions: The most recent enterprise-wide risk analysis covering every system that creates, receives, maintains or transmits ePHI. It must list threats, vulnerabilities, likelihood, impact and risk levels, and be dated within the past 12 months.

title: Risk management plan
instructions: The risk management or remediation plan that follows from the risk analysis, showing each risk's treatment, owner, target date and current status.

title: Sanction policy
instructions: The workforce sanction policy for violations of security and privacy policies, plus the (redacted) record of any sanctions applied during the audit period.

title: Information system activity review
instructions: Evidence that audit logs, access reports and security incident reports for ePHI systems are reviewed regularly: the review procedure and two completed review records from the audit period.

title: Security Official designation
instructions: The signed document appointing the HIPAA Security Official, with their responsibilities, and the matching appointment for the Privacy Officer.

title: Termination procedures
instructions: Offboarding records for three workforce members who left during the audit period, showing access to ePHI systems was removed on or before their last day, with timestamps.

title: Access authorization and review
instructions: The procedure for granting and changing access to ePHI, plus the most recent user access review for the EHR system showing who approved each role and which accounts were removed.

title: HIPAA security awareness training
instructions: Training platform report showing HIPAA privacy and security training completion for the whole workforce (including contractors) in the audit period, with completion dates and anyone overdue.

title: Protection from malicious software
instructions: Endpoint protection console screenshot showing coverage across all workstations and servers that access ePHI, with definitions up to date. The date must be visible.

title: Security incident response and log
instructions: The security incident response procedure and the incident log for the audit period, showing how each incident was identified, contained, documented and resolved.

title: Data backup plan
instructions: The data backup plan for ePHI, the backup schedule and retention settings, and the record of the most recent successful restore test with its date and scope.

title: Disaster recovery and emergency mode plan
instructions: The disaster recovery plan and emergency mode operation plan, plus the report from the most recent test or tabletop exercise and any actions that came out of it.

title: Periodic security evaluation
instructions: The most recent technical and non-technical evaluation of HIPAA Security Rule compliance (internal or third-party), with findings and remediation status.

title: Business associate agreements
instructions: The business associate inventory and signed BAAs for the five vendors with the most ePHI access (e.g. cloud hosting, EHR, billing, backup, email). Each BAA must include the 164.314(a) required terms.

title: Facility access controls
instructions: The facility security plan, badge access logs for one sampled week for areas holding ePHI systems, and the visitor log for the same week.

title: Workstation security
instructions: Screenshots of the device management policy showing automatic screen lock, disk encryption and restricted local admin rights on workstations that access ePHI.

title: Device and media disposal
instructions: The media disposal and re-use procedure and certificates of destruction (or wipe records) for devices and media retired during the audit period.

title: Unique user IDs and automatic logoff
instructions: Evidence that every EHR user has a unique ID (no shared accounts) and that sessions log off automatically after inactivity: a user list export and the session timeout setting.

title: Encryption of ePHI at rest
instructions: Cloud console or system screenshots showing encryption at rest for every database, file store and backup holding ePHI, with the key management service used.

title: Audit controls
instructions: Configuration showing activity on ePHI systems is logged (who accessed which record, and when), where logs are stored and how long they are kept, plus a sample log extract.

title: Integrity controls
instructions: Evidence of the controls that stop ePHI being altered or destroyed improperly, such as database change auditing, checksums or immutable backups, with a short description of each.

title: Person or entity authentication (MFA)
instructions: Identity provider screenshot showing multi-factor authentication enforced for all users with access to ePHI, including remote and administrator access. The date must be visible.

title: Transmission security
instructions: Evidence that ePHI is encrypted in transit: TLS 1.2+ on public endpoints (e.g. an SSL Labs report), encrypted email or secure messaging settings, and VPN settings for remote access.

title: Documentation retention
instructions: The document retention policy showing HIPAA policies, procedures and records are kept for at least six years, and the version history of the security policies.

title: Breach notification procedure
instructions: The breach notification procedure (risk assessment steps, the 60-day notification timeline, who notifies HHS and individuals) and the breach log for the audit period, even if empty.
